finalText:
**Root cause: Redis went down and never came back, and the queue backlog eventually OOM-killed the service.**

Timeline:

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:07–02:31:26 | 12 failed reconnect attempts, roughly every 2 min |
| ongoing | cache miss storms, timeouts, queue depth climbing past `500` max |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory from request backlog |
| 02:31:52 | supervisor kills process group, service down |

Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` never came back online. That forced every request onto direct store reads, which couldn't keep up, so the queue grew unbounded instead of shedding load, until memory ran out.

Next: bring Redis back up and check why nothing capped the queue at 500 instead of just warning.
